problems.quote: The annual sinking‑fund deposit is P × CRF
problems.problem: The Capital Recovery Factor (CRF) gives the total annual payment (interest + principal recovery) for a loan, not the sinking-fund deposit alone. The sinking-fund deposit to accumulate P at rate r is P × r/[(1+r)^n − 1], which is smaller than P × CRF.
problems.correction: The annual capital recovery amount (total outlay) is P × CRF; the sinking-fund deposit is P × r/[(1+r)^n − 1]
problems.verifierReason: CRF is loan payment, not sinking fund deposit; correction correctly separates them.
